reviews.text:
For the past two years, Roma has been in the care of Tails of the City and it has been an exceptional experience.

Gary and Ken create such a warm and loving environment, and Roma has always been happy and excited to spend time with them which says everything.

They are incredibly kind, reliable, and genuinely care about the dogs they look after. Very grateful for everything they’ve done for Roma and couldn’t recommend them more.

If I could give them 10 ✨’s, I would. Ken & Gary are extraordinary at what they do, and care for my dog as if she is their own. Mala has had the best possible care (and fun!) with them - they are patient, trustworthy, knowledgeable, and kind and even taught little Mala how to like cats! (Miracle workers). They keep me updated throughout the day with photos and videos and always let me know how’s she’s doing especially if they notice something important. Highly recommend them. ⭐️

Gary and Ken are the most amazing at taking care of our dog. They really truly want the best for your dog and will go the extra mile. Leaving our dog with them means I know he will have the best time and knowing he is in such good care means I really don’t have to worry about him when he is in their care.

Ken and Gary have been such a big part of our pup’s life. They helped her become comfortable with walking in a pack and she loves to see them for cuddles and play time. They are always quick to respond and flexible. Whenever Lana is with them we get regular updates. They are great for walks or house-sitting, highly recommended.

The only place I trust with my dog. Theres not enough stars i can give these guys.

Our rescue dog does not like most people/dogs and yet she feels totally at home in Gary and Kens place.

These guys are by the far best. We trusted them with our elderly dog, and with our dog who was afraid of most people but loved them. They are a perfect combination of affection plus professional (with medications, allergies, etc). Cannot recommend enough.

No one will take better care of your dog than Ken & Gary. The level of attention and love they give is amazing- my pup Brenda is always so excited to see them. As a rescue dog they’ve made a huge contribution to her socialisation and I cannot recommend them highly enough.

If I could give Tails of the City 1 million stars, I would. They took a chance on our little girl Cheesey, who was afraid of almost all people, and treated her like their own dog. Through her time at Tails, we watched her blossom, trust, and become more confident, sassy and sweet as a result. Cheesey was lucky enough to be a "daycare" dog and spend three glorious days a week with Team Tails. To say Tails changed our lives and Cheesey's life is an understatement. Reliability: I knew when it was Cheesey's drop-off time, it would run like clockwork. Communication: Ken and Gary are always honest and upfront. Compassion: Not only are they the biggest dog (and cat) lovers you'll ever meet, they put themselves in the owners shoes and go above and beyond. They are so empathetic and wonderful and make the world a better place. And, on top of that, the basics are covered! You dog will be walked, fed, doted on, cuddled (or left alone if that's their thing), and if they ever decide they don't want to do doggy day care anymore, they can go into professional photography, because the pup-pictures are just that good. We said goodbye to Tails because we moved away and it was by far the hardest thing about the move. Hard for us, but good for you, because if you are very very lucky, there might be room for your dog to be treated as well as ours. Team Tails forever.

The Tails team have been walking and caring for our dog for over a year now, and we love working with them!! Our dog is so excited to see them (and resident dog Max!) and they truly make him part of their family. Very professional and friendly - we trust them whole heartedly with our fur baby.

Tails of the City is amazing! Our dog goes there every week for the daycare and she absolutely loves it. Gary and Ken provide us with lovely pictures and videos which make us feel not only that our dog is safe there but that she is having loads of fun (and so are they!). It is definitely her favorite day of the week. I used to joke that she prefers Gary to us, but I’m starting to suspect that is actually true.

Highly recommended!

Gary and Ken are Mochis home away from home, and I couldn’t be more grateful to have them for daycare, overnights, and holidays. Mochi loses her mind when I say “tails” because she loves it so much- every day is filled with fun, snuggles, walks, and her best dog buddies. I feel so lucky that I can go on holidays with total peace of mind knowing she’s having an equally fun time with them, and I never have to worry. All the dogs are so well behaved and they create such a great environment for all the furry friends! 🥹🥹❤️❤️
Gary and Ken (who run Tails of the City) are the people I trust most with looking after my Frenchie, Albie, whilst I'm at work / away from Amsterdam. …

Tails In The City is simply the best dog service imaginable.  I have moved for work quite a bit since I first got my dog Penny, and this is the only daycare, boarding experience she is fundamentally happy to go to.  Ken and Gary care so …
